rules.title: Scoped sessions
rules.text: Use one session per request or unit of work and always close it.

rules.title: Use 2.0 style
rules.text: Use SQLAlchemy 2.0 style select() and typed Mapped columns.

rules.title: Eager loading
rules.text: Use selectinload or joinedload to avoid N+1 queries.

rules.title: Alembic migrations
rules.text: Generate migrations with Alembic and review the autogenerated script before committing.
